data.value: How much of every peso sold is left after the cost of what was sold?

data.name: Ind_MargenBruto_Que
data.value: The share of revenue left after covering the cost of sales (COGS and its depreciation). It shows pricing power and control over direct costs.

data.name: Ind_MargenBruto_Mejorar
data.value: Review prices and discounts, renegotiate with suppliers, cut waste and sell more of what carries the best margin.

data.name: Ind_MargenBruto_Regla
data.value: A gross margin that falls while sales rise usually means price is being given away or direct costs got out of hand.

data.name: Ind_MargenEbitda_Pregunta
data.value: Is the operation profitable before interest, taxes and depreciation?

data.name: Ind_MargenEbitda_Que
data.value: Operating profit plus depreciation and amortization over revenue: an approximation of what the business generates before financing and taxes.

data.name: Ind_MargenEbitda_Formula
data.value: (Operating profit + depreciation and amortization) ÷ Revenue (12 months)

data.name: Ind_MargenEbitda_Mejorar
data.value: Improve gross margin, control administrative and selling expenses and grow without fixed costs rising at the same pace.

data.name: Ind_MargenEbitda_Regla
data.value: EBITDA is not cash: it does not deduct investments, working capital, interest or taxes.

data.name: Ind_MargenOperacional_Pregunta
data.value: Is the operation profitable after depreciation?

data.name: Ind_MargenOperacional_Que
data.value: Operating profit over revenue: what the core activity leaves after all operating costs and expenses, including depreciation.

data.name: Ind_MargenOperacional_Mejorar
data.value: Improve gross margin, remove expenses that do not generate sales and review the productivity of the administrative structure.

data.name: Ind_MargenOperacional_Regla
data.value: If the operating margin is low and the net margin is high, profit probably comes from non-operating income that will not repeat.

data.name: Ind_MargenNeto_Pregunta
data.value: How much of every peso sold is left for the owners?

data.name: Ind_MargenNeto_Que
data.value: Net profit over revenue, after financial expenses, other non-operating income and expenses, and taxes.

data.name: Ind_MargenNeto_Mejorar
data.value: Reduce financial cost, clean up non-operating expenses and improve operating margins.

data.name: Ind_MargenNeto_Regla
data.value: Always compare net margin with operating margin: the gap is what interest, taxes and other items consume.

data.name: Ind_MargenFlujoLibre_Pregunta
data.value: How much free cash does the business leave per peso sold?

data.name: Ind_MargenFlujoLibre_Que
data.value: Operating free cash flow (after taxes, working capital and operating investments) over revenue. It comes from the Cash flow model.

data.name: Ind_MargenFlujoLibre_Formula
data.value: Operating free cash flow ÷ Revenue (12 months)

data.name: Ind_MargenFlujoLibre_Mejorar
data.value: Release working capital (receivables and inventory), postpone investments that do not add cash and improve operating profitability.

data.name: Ind_MargenFlujoLibre_Regla
data.value: A company can show profits and still have negative free cash flow if it invests heavily or finances its customers.

data.name: Ind_ConversionCaja_Pregunta
data.value: How much of what the operation earns becomes available cash?

data.name: Ind_ConversionCaja_Que
data.value: Ratio of operating free cash flow to EBITDA. Close to 100% means almost all EBITDA reaches cash; very low or negative means it stays in receivables, inventory or investments.

data.name: Ind_ConversionCaja_Formula
data.value: Operating free cash flow ÷ EBITDA (12 months)

data.name: Ind_ConversionCaja_Mejorar
data.value: Shorten the collection cycle, lower inventory, negotiate supplier terms and prioritize the highest-return investments.

data.name: Ind_ConversionCaja_Regla
data.value: If EBITDA is positive but conversion is low, the problem is not margin but working capital or investments.

data.name: Ind_Roa_Pregunta
data.value: How well do we use our assets to generate profit?

data.name: Ind_Roa_Que
data.value: Net profit of the last 12 months over total assets at the cutoff.

data.name: Ind_Roa_Mejorar
data.value: Raise profit with the same assets, sell unproductive assets and improve inventory and receivables turnover.

data.name: Ind_Roa_Regla
data.value: A low ROA in an asset-heavy company is normal: compare it with companies in the same sector.

data.name: Ind_Roe_Pregunta
data.value: What return do the owners earn on their investment?

data.name: Ind_Roe_Que
data.value: Net profit over 12 months relative to equity at the cutoff. It is inflated when the company borrows heavily: read it together with leverage.

data.name: Ind_Roe_Mejorar
data.value: Improve net margin, turn assets over better and use debt only when the return exceeds its cost.

data.name: Ind_Roe_Regla
data.value: A high ROE with very high debt is not strength: it is risk.

data.name: Ind_Dso_Pregunta
data.value: How many days do we take to collect?

data.name: Ind_Dso_Que
data.value: Average days customers take to pay, estimated from the receivables balance and 12-month sales.

data.name: Ind_Dso_Mejorar
data.value: Invoice on time, set clear terms, follow up on collections and offer early-payment discounts.

data.name: Ind_Dso_Regla
data.value: Every day the collection period shrinks frees up cash without selling another peso.

data.name: Ind_Dio_Pregunta
data.value: How many days do we take to sell what we hold in stock?

data.name: Ind_Dio_Que
data.value: Average days inventory stays before it is sold, from the inventory balance and 12-month cost of sales.

data.name: Ind_Dio_Mejorar
data.value: Match purchases to demand, clear slow-moving items and plan production better.

data.name: Ind_Dio_Regla
data.value: Inventory that does not turn is idle cash and an obsolescence risk.

data.name: Ind_Dpo_Pregunta
data.value: How many days do we take to pay suppliers?

data.name: Ind_Dpo_Que
data.value: Average days to pay current suppliers, from their balance and 12-month cost of sales. More days finance the operation, but paying too late harms the relationship.

data.name: Ind_Dpo_Mejorar
data.value: Negotiate longer terms without losing discounts or risking supply.

data.name: Ind_Dpo_Regla
data.value: Suppliers are free financing only as long as agreed terms are respected.

data.name: Ind_CicloEfectivo_Pregunta
data.value: How many days pass from when we pay until we collect?

data.name: Ind_CicloEfectivo_Que
data.value: Adds receivable days and inventory days and subtracts payable days: the days the company must finance with its own cash.

data.name: Ind_CicloEfectivo_Formula
data.value: Receivable days + Inventory days − Payable days

data.name: Ind_CicloEfectivo_Mejorar
data.value: Shorten collection and inventory and lengthen supplier payment within reason.

data.name: Ind_CicloEfectivo_Regla
data.value: A long cycle demands working capital: without cash, it is paid with debt.

data.name: Ind_RotacionActivos_Pregunta
data.value: How many times a year do we sell the value of our assets?

data.name: Ind_RotacionActivos_Que
data.value: 12-month revenue over total assets: how much sales each peso invested in assets generates.

data.name: Ind_RotacionActivos_Mejorar
data.value: Sell more with the same structure, dispose of idle assets and avoid investments that do not raise sales.

data.name: Ind_RotacionActivos_Regla
data.value: Low-margin businesses need to turn over a lot; high-margin ones can turn over less.

data.name: Ind_RotacionInventario_Pregunta
data.value: How many times a year is inventory renewed?

data.name: Ind_RotacionInventario_Que
data.value: 12-month cost of sales over inventory at the cutoff: how many times inventory is sold and replenished in the year.

data.name: Ind_RotacionInventario_Mejorar
data.value: Cut slow items, buy in smaller lots and align production with sales.

data.name: Ind_RotacionInventario_Regla
data.value: A falling turnover often warns before sales do that something is not selling.

data.name: Ind_GastosOperacionales_Pregunta
data.value: How much of what we sell goes to administrative and selling expenses?

data.name: Ind_GastosOperacionales_Que
data.value: Weight of operating expenses (administrative and selling) over 12-month revenue.

data.name: Ind_GastosOperacionales_Mejorar
data.value: Freeze fixed costs, automate processes and grow sales without growing the structure.

data.name: Ind_GastosOperacionales_Regla
data.value: If expenses grow faster than sales, the margin is eating itself.

data.name: Ind_CapitalTrabajoIngresos_Pregunta
data.value: How much capital does the business need per peso it sells?

data.name: Ind_CapitalTrabajoIngresos_Que
data.value: Working capital (current assets minus current liabilities) over 12-month revenue. It shows how much operating investment growth requires. If negative, the short term is not covered and it is flagged red.

data.name: Ind_CapitalTrabajoIngresos_Mejorar
data.value: Reduce receivables and inventory and negotiate supplier terms.

data.name: Ind_CapitalTrabajoIngresos_Regla
data.value: Growing consumes working capital: the higher this indicator, the more cash each new peso of sales asks for.

data.name: Ind_RazonCorriente_Pregunta
data.value: Can we pay what falls due in the short term with what we have available?

data.name: Ind_RazonCorriente_Que
data.value: Current assets over current liabilities: how many pesos of short-term assets there are per peso of short-term debt.

data.name: Ind_RazonCorriente_Mejorar
data.value: Move debt from short to long term, collect receivables and avoid tying up cash in slow-to-convert assets.

data.name: Ind_RazonCorriente_Regla
data.value: Below 1.0 the company owes more in the short term than it holds in the short term.

data.name: Ind_PruebaAcida_Pregunta
data.value: Can we cover the short term without selling inventory?

data.name: Ind_PruebaAcida_Que
data.value: Like the current ratio but without inventory, the current asset hardest to turn into cash.

data.name: Ind_PruebaAcida_Mejorar
data.value: Speed up collection, reduce inventory and renegotiate near-term maturities.

data.name: Ind_PruebaAcida_Regla
data.value: If the current ratio is good but the quick ratio is weak, liquidity depends on selling inventory.

data.name: Ind_RazonEfectivo_Pregunta
data.value: Can we cover the short term with cash alone?

data.name: Ind_RazonEfectivo_Que
data.value: Cash and banks over current liabilities: the strictest liquidity measure.

data.name: Ind_RazonEfectivo_Mejorar
data.value: Keep a cash cushion, schedule payments better and negotiate available credit lines.

data.name: Ind_RazonEfectivo_Regla
data.value: A very low cash ratio leaves the company one bad month away from a cash crisis.

data.name: Ind_CapitalTrabajo_Pregunta
data.value: How much do we have left (or short) after covering the short term?

data.name: Ind_CapitalTrabajo_Que
data.value: Difference between current assets and current liabilities. Positive: the short term is covered; negative: there is more short-term debt than short-term assets.

data.name: Ind_CapitalTrabajo_Mejorar
data.value: Generate operating cash, lengthen debt maturities and reduce unnecessary receivables and inventory.

data.name: Ind_CapitalTrabajo_Regla
data.value: Negative working capital is not always bad (some businesses collect before they pay), but it needs watching.

data.name: Ind_Endeudamiento_Pregunta
data.value: How much of what we own is financed by third parties?

data.name: Ind_Endeudamiento_Que
data.value: Total liabilities over total assets: the percentage of assets financed with debts and obligations.

data.name: Ind_Endeudamiento_Mejorar
data.value: Capitalize profits, pay down debt with free cash flow and avoid financing assets with short-term debt.

data.name: Ind_Endeudamiento_Regla
data.value: The higher the debt ratio, the less room for error the company has in a bad streak.

data.name: Ind_DeudaNetaEbitda_Pregunta
data.value: In how many years would we repay the debt with what the operation generates?

data.name: Ind_DeudaNetaEbitda_Que
data.value: Financial debt minus cash, divided by 12-month EBITDA. It is the measure banks use most to size repayment capacity.

data.name: Ind_DeudaNetaEbitda_Formula
data.value: (Financial obligations − Cash and banks) ÷ EBITDA (12 months)

data.name: Ind_DeudaNetaEbitda_Mejorar
data.value: Raise EBITDA, use free cash flow to pay down debt and avoid new debt that does not generate a return.

data.name: Ind_DeudaNetaEbitda_Regla
data.value: With positive net debt and negative EBITDA there is no way to repay from operations: it is an alert, not a number.

data.name: Ind_CoberturaIntereses_Pregunta
data.value: How many times does the operation cover the interest?

data.name: Ind_CoberturaIntereses_Que
data.value: 12-month EBITDA over financial expenses for the same period.

data.name: Ind_CoberturaIntereses_Mejorar
data.value: Refinance at a lower rate, reduce expensive debt and raise EBITDA.

data.name: Ind_CoberturaIntereses_Regla
data.value: When coverage nears 1.0, almost all operating profit goes to interest.

data.name: Ind_CostoDeuda_Pregunta
data.value: What does debt cost us, on average?

data.name: Ind_CostoDeuda_Que
data.value: 12-month financial expenses over financial debt at the cutoff. It is an estimate: financial expenses may include other items and debt changes during the year.

data.name: Ind_CostoDeuda_Mejorar
data.value: Renegotiate rates, replace expensive debt with cheaper debt and adjust loan terms.

data.name: Ind_CostoDeuda_Regla
data.value: If the cost of debt exceeds the return on what it finances, borrowing destroys value.

data.name: Ind_ApalancamientoFinanciero_Pregunta
data.value: How many pesos of assets does each peso of equity support?

data.name: Ind_ApalancamientoFinanciero_Que
data.value: Total assets over equity: how much debt amplifies results, for better and for worse.

data.name: Ind_ApalancamientoFinanciero_Mejorar
data.value: Retain profits to strengthen equity and moderate the use of debt.

data.name: Ind_ApalancamientoFinanciero_Regla
data.value: Leverage multiplies gains in good times and losses in bad times.

data.name: Ind_CrecimientoIngresos_Pregunta
data.value: Are we selling more than a year ago?

data.name: Ind_CrecimientoIngresos_Que
data.value: Change in revenue over the last 12 months versus the previous 12 months. It needs 24 months of history.

data.name: Ind_CrecimientoIngresos_Mejorar
data.value: Add customers and channels, adjust prices and protect service to current customers.

data.name: Ind_CrecimientoIngresos_Regla
data.value: Growing without sustaining margin and cash flow is not growing well.

data.name: Ind_CrecimientoEbitda_Que
data.value: Change in 12-month EBITDA versus the previous 12 months. It needs 24 months of history.

data.name: Ind_CrecimientoEbitda_Mejorar
data.value: Grow sales while controlling expenses and protect margins.

data.name: Ind_CrecimientoEbitda_Regla
data.value: If EBITDA grows faster than revenue, the business is gaining scale.
